# `posexplode_outer`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
posexplode_outer(expr)
```

Separates the elements of array `expr` into multiple rows with positions, or the elements of map `expr` into multiple rows and columns with positions. Unless specified otherwise, uses the column name `pos` for position, `col` for elements of the array or `key` and `value` for elements of the map.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `generator_funcs` |
| Kind | generator (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- posexplode_outer, example 1
> SELECT posexplode_outer(array(10,20));
0 | 10
1 | 20
```

```sql
-- posexplode_outer, example 2
> SELECT posexplode_outer(collection => array(10,20));
0 | 10
1 | 20
```
